cues.en: The most successful people that I know.
cues.zh: 我認識最成功的人，

cues.en: And I'm not just talking about developers.
cues.zh: 而且不只是開發人員，

cues.en: I'm talking about all the successful people that I know are masters of learning.
cues.zh: 我說的是所有認識的成功人士，他們都是學習高手。

cues.en: We all have the same amount of time in the day.
cues.zh: 我們每天擁有的時間都一樣。

cues.en: 23 hours, 56 minutes and 26 seconds.
However, some people are able to accomplish more than others.
cues.zh: 然而，有些人能完成的事情比別人多。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: I'm a big proponent of efficiency.
cues.zh: 我非常重視效率。

cues.en: If you're able to learn something in much less time than somebody else, then you can compound the benefit over your lifetime.
cues.zh: 如果你能比別人用少得多的時間學會一件事，這份優勢就能在一生中持續累積。

cues.en: Now, I know many people have different learning abilities, but this isn't a contest with others.
cues.zh: 我知道，每個人的學習能力不同，但這不是和別人的競賽。

cues.en: This is a contest within yourself.
cues.zh: 這是和自己的競賽。

cues.en: Figure out what makes you successful in learning.
cues.zh: 找出讓自己有效學習的方法。

cues.en: Don't compare yourself to others, whether you're a visual learner, or maybe you need to take breaks every 30 minutes.
cues.zh: 別和別人比較；你可能適合視覺學習，也可能需要每 30 分鐘休息一次。

cues.en: Figure out what your best learning style is.
cues.zh: 找出最適合自己的學習方式。

cues.en: Learn how to learn.
cues.zh: 學會如何學習。

cues.en: Don't just watch videos blindly at two times the speed and expect to learn everything.
cues.zh: 不要只是盲目用兩倍速看影片，就期待能學會所有東西。

cues.en: Find the most efficient way that works for you and keep practicing.
cues.zh: 找到對自己最有效率的方法，持續練習。

cues.en: By learning to learn, you become a better developer.
cues.zh: 學會學習，能讓你成為更好的開發人員。

cues.en: As developers, we have to constantly learn throughout our career.
cues.zh: 身為開發人員，整個職涯都必須持續學習。

cues.en: Our learning never stops because technology is constantly evolving.
cues.zh: 因為科技不斷演進，我們的學習永遠不會停止。

cues.en: So if you want to be a successful developer.
cues.zh: 所以，如果想成為成功的開發人員，

cues.en: You have to learn your best learning style.
cues.zh: 就必須了解最適合自己的學習方式。

cues.en: It is better to figure out what makes you tick, what makes things clearer for you now then later on in your career.
cues.zh: 與其等到職涯後期，現在就弄清楚什麼能讓自己投入、什麼能讓事情更清楚，會更好。

cues.en: Start early.
cues.zh: 早點開始。

cues.en: Figure out what is the best method for you because it's going to be a skill that you're going to use throughout your career.
cues.zh: 找出最適合自己的方法，因為這項技能會貫穿你的整個職涯。
